english.title: Operator of UK aircraft fail to cause to be produced documents requested
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed, within a reasonable time after being requested to do so by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), an authorised person, to cause to be produced to that person

(A)_[the documents referred to in Schedule 10 to the Air Navigation Order 2016 as Documents A, B and G]_
(B)_[the aircraft log book, engine log books and variable pitch propeller log books required under the Air Navigation Order 2016 to be kept]_
(C)_[the weight schedule required to be preserved under article 43(4) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(D)_[the documents referred to in Schedule 10 to the Air Navigation Order 2016 as Documents D, E, F and H, the aircraft being a public transport or commercial operation aircraft]_
(E)_[the records of flight times, duty periods and rest periods which you were required by article 175(4) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 to preserve and such other documents as may be required for the purpose of determining whether those records were complete and accurate]_
(F)_[an operations manual, namely **(..SPECIFY OPERATIONS MANUAL..), required to be made available under article 116(4)(a) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(G)_[the record made by a flight data recorder required to be carried by or under the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 235(2) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
